  import {
    httpRequest,
    reportRequest
  } from '@/utils/api'
  import {
    shareAppMessage
  } from '@/utils/app.js'
  import {
    mapGetters,
    mapMutations
  } from 'vuex'

  export default {
    data() {
      return {
        habitList: [],
        habitInfo: {},
        habitDetailList: [],
        activeHabitId: 'hb-14'
      }
    },
    onLoad(options) {
      if (options.id) {
        this.activeHabitId = options.id
      }

      this.getHabitList()
      this.getHabitInfo()

      uni.setNavigationBarTitle({
        title: '七大生活习惯'
      })

      reportRequest({
        eventType: 'enterPage'
      })
    },
    onShareAppMessage() {
      return shareAppMessage({
        title: this.newTitle
      })
    },
    computed: {
      ...mapGetters(['user', 'lang', 'langMap']),
      newTitle() {
        return this.lang === 'en' ? '音昱生活' : '音昱生活'
      }
    },
    methods: {
      handleItem(habitId) {
        this.activeHabitId = habitId
        this.habitDetailList = []
        this.getHabitInfo(habitId)
      },
      getHabitList() {
        httpRequest({
          url: 'organizer/habitList',
          method: 'get',
          success: res => {
            this.habitList = res.data
          }
        })
      },
      getHabitInfo() {
        uni.showLoading()
        httpRequest({
          url: 'organizer/habitInfo',
          method: 'get',
          data: {
            habitId: this.activeHabitId
          },
          success: res => {
            this.habitInfo = res.data
            this.habitDetailList = res.data.habitDetailList
            uni.hideLoading()
          }
        })
      }
    }
  }
</script>
